title: Question 23
passage:
Who painted the mural outside our office?
A. It’s right next to the employee entrance. B. We repainted that wall last spring. C. Maya from the front desk painted it after work.
passageZh:
我們辦公室外的壁畫是誰畫的？
A. 就在員工入口旁邊。
B. 我們去年春天重新粉刷過那面牆。
C. 是服務台的 Maya 下班後畫的。
